strings.The accepted specifications must identif: The accepted specifications must identify the work to be delivered and the quality of materials and workmanship expected. strings.The agreement should allocate responsibi: The agreement should allocate responsibility for water supply, temporary power, debris removal and disposal charges. Sand, aggregate and other materials must come through lawful supply channels, with transport or royalty documentation where required. Any discovered contamination or hazardous material should be isolated and assessed before work continues in the affected area.
strings.The client must have the legal authority: The client must have the legal authority to commission work on the property and must disclose ownership disputes, boundary objections, easements and restrictions affecting the site. Delays or additional protection caused by undisclosed conditions will be discussed and documented rather than treated as an automatic open-ended charge.
strings.The company may arrange suitable workers: The company may arrange suitable workers, suppliers and subcontractors for the agreed scope while retaining the responsibilities assigned to it by the contract and law. Attendance, labour deployment and specialist work should be documented where required for the project.
strings.The company name, branding and website c: The company name, branding and website content may be used to identify or discuss our services, but must not be copied or presented as another business’s work without permission. Rights in third-party photographs and illustrations remain with their respective owners.
